- TN-TEACH-D-LOG — sample driving log referenced but not present in the extracted pages (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- TN-TEACH-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- TN-TEACH-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the permit holding period, the required supervised hours, the road test length and the teen crash rates (for example sec17-F03, sec17-F18, sec17-F19, sec17-F23) can change and must be refreshed from official Tennessee sources.
